test_title: PYST 24: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - GA (Held On 26 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is a modern trend regarding business licenses?

options.text: Increasing the amount of time it takes to get them.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Making them easier to obtain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The modern global economic trend focuses heavily on the **Ease of Doing Business**, a framework designed to reduce the regulatory burden on private enterprises to foster **economic growth**.
 
• Governments worldwide are implementing **Single Window Clearance Systems**, which allow entrepreneurs to submit all necessary **business license** applications through a unified digital portal, reducing the need to visit multiple departments.
 
• The process of **Digitization** has transformed licensing from a paper-based, slow system into an **e-governance** model, ensuring transparency and significantly shortening the turnaround time for approvals.
 
• Simplifying the acquisition of licenses is a strategic move to attract **Foreign Direct Investment (FDI)**, as investors prefer markets with minimal **bureaucratic red tape** and predictable regulatory environments.
 
• By making licenses easier to obtain, authorities encourage the transition of businesses from the **informal sector** to the **formal economy**, which helps in expanding the national **tax base** and ensuring better labor law compliance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Economic Liberalization**:

 
 
• Refers to the reduction of state involvement in the economy, where **deregulation** of licensing (formerly known as the **License Raj** in India) allows for greater **market competition**.
 
• Involves the removal of **entry barriers** for new firms, which stimulates **innovation** and prevents **monopolies** from dominating the market.
 
 
 
• **Regulatory Compliance**:
 
 
• While licenses are easier to obtain, the focus has shifted toward **post-approval monitoring** and **self-certification** schemes to ensure businesses adhere to environmental and safety standards.
 
• The **World Bank** recently transitioned from the **Doing Business** report to the **Business Ready (B-READY)** project, which evaluates the business environment based on regulatory quality and public services.
